buxidine.translation: [化] 黄杨叶碱; 黄杨定

buxine.definition:
n. An alkaloid obtained from the Buxus sempervirens, or common
   box tree. It is identical with bebeerine; -- called also buxina.

buxom.definition: s. (of a female body) healthily plump and vigorous;
buxom.translation: a. (妇女)丰满的, 健美的

buxomer.definition:
s. (of a woman's body) having a large bosom and pleasing curves
s. (of a female body) healthily plump and vigorous;
buxomer.translation: 活泼的,健美丰满的 (比较级)

buxomest.definition:
s. (of a woman's body) having a large bosom and pleasing curves
s. (of a female body) healthily plump and vigorous;
buxomest.translation: 活泼的,健美丰满的 (最高级)

buxomness.definition: n. the bodily property of being attractively plump and vigorous and (of women) full-bosomed

buxus.definition: n type genus of the Buxaceae
